C1.worst_defect: The hero and intro lean on developer framing ('headless commerce framework', plugin/npm talk) before saying in shop terms that two staff can sell at a counter tomorrow with a scanner and their own card terminal.

C2.worst_defect: The refund limit is stated honestly but in server terms: 'The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls; see Plugin setup.' A shop owner cannot tell whether that is a chore for them or for the freelancer.

C3.worst_defect: The device-key path has a known gap the owner must fix by hand: 'On plugin 0.3.0 the role it creates (vendurepos-pos-till) has the step 4 permissions except ReadOrder, so add ReadOrder to that role yourself.' Role setup is also split between Quick start step 4 and Connect a till.

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting 'When till updates need attention' hands the shop owner an errorCode list ('match its errorCode in the list below', register_session_already_open, register_closure_number_invalid) on the same page as counter-staff advice, followed by needs_admin GraphQL (tallyNeedsAdminCommands / tallyResolveNeedsAdmin). Two audiences are mixed in one section.

C5.worst_defect: The payment-screen screenshot shows a large empty white cart area that reads as a broken render. The cashier-sheet screenshot differs between devices: the desktop version lacks the 'Last synced 10:07 PM / Sync now' line that the phone version shows.

C6.worst_defect: On the phone, the hero till screenshot crops the category chip row mid-word ('Gif'). Otherwise the phone layout is clean: the comparison table stacks well and code wraps.

C7.worst_defect: og-image.png crops the till screenshot through the middle of a product card at the bottom edge, so a shared link shows a half-cut tile. Everything else is clean: titles, JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap, robots, search API, real 404 status, Lighthouse 97-100.

overall_worst.defect: Troubleshooting 'When till updates need attention' tells 'the store owner' to 'match its errorCode in the list below' and then lists raw codes (register_session_already_open, register_closure_number_invalid) next to needs_admin GraphQL operations. A non-developer owner gets a developer runbook in the middle of counter guidance.
overall_worst.fix: Keep the counter steps ('leave the app open, don't reload, call the owner') on the page. Move the errorCode list and the GraphQL into a clearly labelled 'For whoever runs your Vendure server' block or page. Give the owner one plain sentence: copy the line from the sync log and send it to your developer.
